# Normal forms of named exchanges need exactly decided apartness on the stretch

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For a symmetric joining relation, two arrangements and their given inverses of a finite stretch (Reindexes) are connected by adjacent unjoined commutations exactly where they orient joined pairs alike (rearranges_iff, with no decision). Given a Boolean decision of apartness for distinct exchanges of the stretch (DecidesApart), normalForm constructs a reachable lexicographically least arrangement. Two arrangements are reachable exactly where their normal forms agree over the stretch (normalForm_iff); the form is idempotent and least at the first differing position (normalForm_normal, normalForm_least). A complete natural-number-valued invariant compared on the finite stretch (CompleteInvariant) exists exactly where that apartness decision exists (complete_iff); pair_rearranges and decides_of_complete give necessity. For a world with a containing footprint, normalize is reached by independent commutations, preserves the seven world premises both ways and the order under renumbering (normalize_premises, normalize_precedes). Naming exchanges by their steps in the original world, normalizing any independent reordering gives the same exchanges and per-relatum SameAt as the original normal form (normalize_reorder).

Canonical source: [OrderNormal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OrderNormal.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- A finite stretch S,m, natural-number names, and each arrangement and inverse satisfying Reindexes; joining is symmetric.
- The normal form uses DecidesApart to decide not being joined for distinct exchanges of the stretch; decidability of joining is not inferred. The relational characterization rearranges_iff needs no such decision.
- CompleteInvariant is Nat-valued and compared only on the finite stretch. World normalization additionally requires footprint containment; normalize_reorder requires independent reordering and retains the original naming.

P88 consumes P78/P78b sorting and order, without counting the reused converse as an independent result. Its output is the canonical representative of finite named arrangements and the exact decision boundary, connected to worlds through Footprinted. The reading is AI-authored, adopted on Ren's delegation; see integration §109.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 101 theorems of Becoming.OrderNormal all have empty axiom reports, among them rearranges_iff, normalForm_iff, normalForm_normal, normalForm_least, complete_iff, decides_of_complete, Footprinted.normalize_premises, Footprinted.normalize_reorder and Triple.not_rearranged. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §109 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

The normal form is relative to given natural-number names and a finite stretch. No unnamed, Foata simultaneous-layer or unbounded-run normal form is given. CompleteInvariant is not an abstract invariant in an arbitrary codomain. Joining is known only up to double negation; the existing relational characterization needs no decision. No actual continuous-time correspondence or ethical conclusion follows.

- Triple: the first and last of three exchanges are joined; reversing their order changes the normal form and prevents reachability. [OrderNormal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OrderNormal.lean)
